question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts constituted the State Finance Commission?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**73rd Amendment Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act** of **1992** was a landmark amendment that introduced **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** in India.
 
• This amendment added a new part, **Part IX**, to the Constitution and inserted **Articles 243 to 243O**.
 
• It mandated the establishment of the **State Finance Commission** to ensure the distribution of financial resources between the state and Panchayati Raj Institutions.
 
• The **State Finance Commission** is constituted every **five years** by the state government as per Article **243I**.
 
• The commission is responsible for recommending the principles for the distribution of funds, grants, and financial resources between the **state government** and **local self-governing bodies**.
 
• The amendment aimed to strengthen grassroots-level democracy and ensure financial autonomy for local bodies.
 
• The **73rd Amendment Act** is applicable to all states except, **Nagaland**, **Meghalaya**, and **Mizoram**, as well as certain areas covered under the **Sixth Schedule**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **74th Amendment Act**__

 __
 
• The **74th Constitutional Amendment Act** introduced provisions for **Urban Local Bodies** (Municipalities).
 
• This amendment added **Part IXA** to the Constitution and inserted Articles **243P to 243ZG**.
 
• It aimed to strengthen urban governance by establishing municipalities and ensuring their financial and administrative autonomy.
 
• It mandated the creation of the **District Planning Committees** and **Metropolitan Planning Committees** for integrated planning at the district and metropolitan levels.
 
 
 
• **75th Amendment Act**__
 __
 
• The **75th Amendment Act** deals with enabling provisions for the establishment of **Rent Control Tribunals**.
 
• The act aimed to streamline the process of rent regulation and dispute resolution in urban areas.
 
• It provided states with the power to establish tribunals for speedy adjudication of rent-related disputes.
 
 
 
• **76th Amendment Act**__
 
 
• The **76th Amendment Act** included the **Tamil Nadu Reservation Act** of 1994 in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• This amendment ensured that the reservation policy of Tamil Nadu, which provides **69% reservation** for backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes, remains protected from judicial review.
 
• The Ninth Schedule was created to shield certain laws from being challenged for violating fundamental rights.
